_comment: Which laws Pip can search. Oklahoma titles come from the Legislature's complete-title PDFs; federal parts come from the eCFR API. 'include' is a list of regular expressions matched against section ids like 11-12-106 or 25-307. Edit this file and re-run the 'Refresh statute library' workflow to change what Pip knows.

oklahoma.name: Cities and Towns
oklahoma._why: Definitions; officers generally (nepotism, removal); the four statutory forms of government (Art. 9-12) and charter cities (Art. 13); general powers; liability; fire/police collective bargaining (Art. 51)

oklahoma.name: Definitions and General Provisions
oklahoma._why: Open Meeting Act, including executive sessions on personnel matters (25 O.S. 307)

oklahoma.name: Labor
oklahoma._why: Wage payment, minimum wage, drug and alcohol testing act, workplace protections

oklahoma.name: Officers
oklahoma._why: Governmental Tort Claims Act (151-200) and Open Records Act (24A), including personnel records

oklahoma.name: Public Health and Safety
oklahoma._why: Medical marijuana provisions, including employment protections

oklahoma.name: Crimes and Punishments
oklahoma._why: Nepotism: public officers appointing relatives (21 O.S. 481-488), cited in OMAG's personnel policies

oklahoma.name: Elections
oklahoma._why: Time off to vote (26 O.S. 7-101), cited in OMAG's personnel policies

oklahoma.name: Jurors
oklahoma._why: Jury service leave and protection from discharge (38 O.S. 34-35), cited in OMAG's personnel policies

federal.name: FLSA for state and local governments
DOT drug and alcohol testing (CDL drivers)

_required: Sections every build must contain. The build fails if one is missing, and Pip keeps using the last good library.
